criteria.statement: First request uses previousId 1 and a from value naming TheJudge (injected fetch)
With an injected clock no request starts less than 3 s after the previous one finished
Malformed error halves 50 to 1; failing size-1 records a skip and advances one id; size regrows after five successes
A frozen file is never overwritten; resume starts after the saved id; state rewritten after each batch
Network error, 10 consecutive failures and repeated rate-limit after one 30 s wait each stop with state saved; empty batch ends cleanly; counts only
Purge without --yes deletes nothing and prints the count; with --yes deletes only a temp suite folder; refuses a path outside it
Every import and purge test uses a temp folder with injected fetch and clock; none names output/rulesguru or passes the global fetch
package.json has eval:rulesguru:import and eval:rulesguru:purge, the entry runs the ignore guard first, and no live request was made during the build
The REQ-232 entry gains the import, freeze, resumable and purge criteria
